puzzleText: To learn more about the illuminaughty's evil plans, it is necessary to hack into their network. Luckily your inside spy has set up a remote desktop machine for you to log into and gain access. However there's just one problem - you don't know what IP address you should remote into. Suddenly you receive an email from your inside spy. But instead of telling you what IP address you should use - he just sent you this riddle and pictures of a bunch of flags. ------------------------------- Ahoy me hearty! If ye wish to sail on cyber seas, Ye must learn to read flags like these: ... So play this game, be a good sport Then ye may sail straight into port! ------------------------------- Decode this message to find out the IP address of the remote computer you can hack into.
hint:
Maritime signal pennants represent numbers
reference
title: Cyber Seas Pirate Hacker
